title: Dundun Trio Bare-Bones Starter Packet
build_target: kenkeni / sangban / doundounba cylindrical drum family
artifact_focus: L2 V5 starter packet for cylindrical membrane drums with shell, head, rope, and trio-tuning gates

required_before_public: Confirm whether scanned planning dimensions are outside diameter, inside diameter, or finished head-seat diameter before CAD/DXF release.
Measure shell wall thickness, head clear diameter, cowhide thickness, rope diameter, and ring stock before treating family-spec.csv or cut-list.csv as fabrication authority.
Collect head-tension, shell-response, pitch, rope-stretch, and ergonomic data before promoting beyond L2.
Review CAD/DXF/design-table outputs against measured templates before any shop-release geometry claim.
Add sourced cultural/provenance notes before expanding public build instructions.

fabrication_authority: none yet; future authority must come from measured templates, reviewed CAD/DXF, or design tables
visual_authority: drawings and photos are reference_only unless paired with a measurement method
runtime_validation: wolfram smoke-check evidence only; no measured model outputs or plots claimed

cultural_provenance.claim: The dundun family has living Mande West African cultural context. This repo documents Tony's Morgan Drums stave-construction work and engineering process while keeping cultural claims modest until sourced review is added.
